error_internal.message: Something went wrong in Kotiko. Check the server log.

error_internal_ref.message: Something went wrong in Kotiko. Check the server log for ref {ref}.
error_internal_ref.description: 500: a bug. REF finds the error in the server log.

error_request_too_large.description: 413: the body is over the limit.

error_invalid_request.message: The server couldn't read that request; details.field names the part to fix.
error_invalid_request.description: 400: a parameter or body field is missing or wrong.

error_invalid_request_content_type.message: Send the body as JSON, with the header Content-Type: application/json.
error_invalid_request_content_type.description: 415: the body was sent with another content type.

error_invalid_request_words.description: 400: the batch add's word list is missing or too long. MAX is the limit.

error_invalid_request_action.description: 400: the pronunciation job's control without an action.

error_invalid_word.message: That change isn't a valid word.
error_invalid_word.description: 400: an edit doesn't make a valid word; details say which field.

error_input_too_long.message: That's a lot of text for one word.
error_input_too_long.description: 400: the add text is over 200 characters.

error_server_key_rejected.message: This Kotiko server didn't accept the access key. Paste it again in Connection.

error_word_gone_scrubbed.message: That word was removed too long ago to restore.

error_word_conflict_duplicate.message: Another word already has that key.
error_word_conflict_duplicate.description: 409: another word has the same language, text and meaning.

error_server_address_invalid.message: This Kotiko server doesn't answer to that address.
error_server_address_invalid.description: 421: the request reached the server by an address it doesn't answer to.

error_server_address_invalid_host_not_al.message: This Kotiko server doesn't answer to {host}. Add it to ALLOWED_HOSTS in .env.
error_server_address_invalid_host_not_al.description: 421: the Host header names a host the server doesn't answer to. HOST is that name.

error_server_address_invalid_no_host.message: This Kotiko server only answers requests without a Host header from this computer.
error_server_address_invalid_no_host.description: 421: a request without a Host header came from another computer.

error_quota_exhausted.message: You've used today's free lookups. Add words yourself, or try again after {time} UTC.
error_quota_exhausted.description: 429: today's free lookups are used up. TIME is HH:MM in UTC.

error_quota_exhausted_today.message: You've used today's free lookups. Add words yourself, or try again tomorrow.
error_quota_exhausted_today.description: 429: today's free lookups are used up; the reset time isn't known.

error_quota_exhausted_payment_required.message: {provider} needs credit on your account before it will look up words, even free ones. Add credit there, or add words yourself.
error_quota_exhausted_payment_required.description: 429: the provider asks for payment (402). PROVIDER is its name.

error_rate_limited.message: Word lookup is busy. Try again in a minute.
error_rate_limited.description: 429: the provider asked to slow down.

error_model_unavailable.message: Word lookup isn't answering right now. Try again in a little while.

error_lookup_timeout.message: That lookup took too long. Try again.
error_lookup_timeout.description: 503: no answer within the add's deadline.

error_bad_lookup_result.message: The lookup came back garbled. Try again, or add the word yourself.
error_bad_lookup_result.description: 502: the model's answer couldn't be used.

error_key_rejected.message: {provider} didn't accept the server's key (LLM_API_KEY). Check it, then restart the server.
error_key_rejected.description: 502: the provider refused the server's key. PROVIDER is its name.

error_lookup_not_set_up.message: Word lookup isn't set up: add LLM_API_KEY to the server's .env and restart it.

error_lookup_failed.description: A lookup failed with a code that has no message of its own.

provider_unknown.description: Stands in for PROVIDER when the provider isn't known.
